packages.name: XxSnap-Modern-x64
packages.launchCondition: ACTION = "ADMIN" OR Installed OR (MsiNTProductType = 1 AND XXSNAP_WINDOWS_MAJOR AND VersionNT64)
packages.launchMessage: XxSnap Modern x64 requires 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11.

packages.name: XxSnap-Modern-x86
packages.launchCondition: ACTION = "ADMIN" OR Installed OR (MsiNTProductType = 1 AND XXSNAP_WINDOWS_MAJOR AND NOT VersionNT64)

packages.name: XxSnap-Legacy-x64
packages.launchCondition: ACTION = "ADMIN" OR Installed OR (MsiNTProductType = 1 AND VersionNT = 601 AND ServicePackLevel >= 1 AND VersionNT64 AND XXSNAP_PLATFORM_UPDATE AND XXSNAP_SHA2)
packages.launchMessage: XxSnap Legacy x64 requires 64-bit Windows 7 SP1 with the Platform Update and SHA-2 support installed.

packages.name: XxSnap-Legacy-x86
packages.launchCondition: ACTION = "ADMIN" OR Installed OR (MsiNTProductType = 1 AND VersionNT = 601 AND ServicePackLevel >= 1 AND NOT VersionNT64 AND XXSNAP_PLATFORM_UPDATE AND XXSNAP_SHA2)
packages.launchMessage: XxSnap Legacy x86 requires 32-bit Windows 7 SP1 with the Platform Update and SHA-2 support installed.
